title: Augment fireside — 'How to Build Companies That Last with Eric Ries' — live to their 300+ student community
summary: Augment.org — the Paris-based learning platform whose instructors include Morgan Housel (Personal Finance course) and Mark Pincus (Building Products Billions Love, Aug 18 live session) — hosts a live fireside on September 15 with Eric on why so many great companies stop being great. With The Lean Startup Eric taught a generation of founders how to build; Incorruptible is about how to last. Students answer live in Q&A.
blockquote: Why do so many great companies stop being great? It's easy to blame bad leaders but Eric Ries thinks the real problem is something else entirely: success changes companies and many of the best organizations drift from what made them worth building in the first place.
attribution_title: Live fireside chat, September 15, 2026 — Augment student community
